feedback:
Written before this candidate races, so I state no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: seven 8 mm sensors at x = -0.024 to +0.024 in 8 mm steps, y = 0.03, and weights in [-2, 2] with antisymmetric signs. The controller values (kp 3.0, kd 0.3, ki 0.4, base_speed 1.3, last_direction) match iteration 4, the best raced design at 91.4, and the geometry change is the main test. Iterations 0 to 4 all ended off_track on every trial, with max_error at 0.061 to 0.064 and 1 to 2 line-loss events per run, so the sensing span is the right lever to test. The geometry arithmetic holds: an 8 mm outer sensor at x = 0.024 sees the 25 mm tape until the robot is about 0.036 m off-centre, versus about 0.032 m for iteration 4.

One confound to watch. The weights [-2, -1.3, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.3, 2] have a slope of about 100 per metre, while iteration 4 used about 125 per metre (weights -2 to 2 over ±0.016). The effective steering gain is therefore about 20 percent lower near the centre, so this race tests sensor span and a softer signal together. Iteration 2 used the same weight profile and scored worse, but it also moved y to 0.05, so it does not isolate this effect. I am approving because the design is valid, the change is clean enough to read, and telemetry from the widened span is worth more than another revision made without it.

What to do next depends on the race. If line_loss_events fall to 1 or fewer and max_error drops below 0.06 on oval and s-bend, keep the seven-sensor span and raise base_speed toward 1.5 if progress stays below about 0.5. If max_error still reaches 0.06 with line loss still occurring, the span was not the limit, so raise kp before adding kd, as iteration 4 suggested. If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.2 with the wider signal, reduce kd toward 0.2 before changing kp. If the result is worse than iteration 4 while line loss is lower, the weaker centre gain is the likely cause, so restore a slope near 125 per metre (for example, weights of ±2 at the outer sensors and ±1.25 at the next pair, with the inner sensors and centre kept at 0 and ±0.6 or the nearest equivalent within the ±2 limit).
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall to 1 or fewer while max_error stays at or above 0.06, raise kp from 3.0 toward 3.5 or 4.0 with kd held at 0.3, because iterations 0 to 4 show the robot loses the tape at bends rather than oscillating (steering_oscillation about 0.1 to 0.2).

If the robot holds the line but progress stays below about 0.5 on oval, raise base_speed from 1.3 toward 1.5, since iteration 1 at base 1.5 reached 0.16 to 0.21 progress and iteration 4 at base 1.3 reached 0.44 on oval.

If the widened span scores below iteration 4 (91.4) while line loss drops, restore the iteration 4 weight slope of about 125 per metre within the ±2 limit (for example weights -2, -1.25, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1.25, 2 with the sensor span unchanged), since the flatter profile lowers the centre gain by about 20 percent.
